title: Mockup artifact
description: A reviewable screen a flow step renders. The `screen` field is the bare id that flow steps/branches reference via `step.screen`; the artifact `id` is the path-stable `<product>/<name>`. frontend-coder builds each screen to match the Mockup, populated from the same Mock Data. `renders` points at a self-contained HTML rendering (the flow-site / Atlas is the runtime renderer); it may be null for a screen that is registered but not yet drawn.

component.description: Owning component (matches a key in docs/acceptance-criteria/index.yaml, e.g. ux-prototyping).

screen.description: The bare screen id that flow steps/branches reference via step.screen (e.g. 'plant-listing'). Resolved by the product-truth validator against every flow's step/branch screen.

summary.description: HUMAN: one-paragraph plain-language description of what the screen shows.

entities.description: Entities the screen renders. Every value must be a member of index.json entity_registry.

source.description: Whether the screen renders mock/demo data or a real system surface.

realization.description: Does the screen EXIST in the repo today? built = drawn and wired; spec = aspirational, not-yet-drawn; mock = sample/demo screen. OPTIONAL — absent defaults to 'built'. Parallels flow.realization.

renders.description: Path to the self-contained HTML rendering, relative to this mockup file's directory (e.g. 'plant-listing.html'). Null when the screen is registered but not yet drawn.

status.description: Lifecycle: is this screen live or retired.

superseded_by.description: id of the artifact replacing this one when status=deprecated.

readiness.description: Review state: has a persona approved it yet.

mock_data_ref.description: id of the Mock Data artifact whose records populate this screen.
